desc:
⚔️ Pack wisely. Strike boldly. 🎒

Buy weapons, armor, potions and pets 💰, pack them into your backpack and watch it fight another player's backpack on its own. Win 10 battles 🏆 before your 5 hearts ❤️ run out!

🧙 7 HEROES, EACH WITH 5 SUBCLASSES
🏹 Ranger · 🧪 Witch · 🪓 Berserker · 🔥 Pyromancer
🛡️ Paladin · ⚡ Stormcaller · 💀 Necromancer

🗡️ 512 painted items and 75 recipes to discover
🔮 Fusions, Mana, Souls, minions and more
👑 Ranked seasons from Bronze to Legend
🗺️ Daily Expedition, Weekly Brawl, Rival Runs, Tavern and Duels
🎁 Daily Bag, bounties and a Wardrobe full of looks

🕹️ CONTROLS
🖱️ PC: drag items into your bags. Press R or right click to rotate.
📱 Mobile: drag with one finger. Tap with a second finger to rotate.
🎮 Controller: the left stick moves the hand. A picks up and places, X rotates, B goes back.

🧠 Smart packing wins. Robux only buy looks and comfort, never power.

🏰 Join the Bags and Blades group for a free banner, a title and 100 Crowns!
